Q00512_BladeUnderFoot/36403-01.htm.text: Gludio Prison Warden: I am the warden of this castle prison. This monster dungeon was discovered only recently. I suspect that other castles also have such dungeons. My duty is to keep this basement prison area safe. Having monsters appear and disappear at will here would hardly let the castle inha…

Q00512_BladeUnderFoot/36403-03.htm.text: Prison Warden: Who are you? I don't see your name on the list of clan members... (This quest is reserved for members of the clan that currently owns this castle.)

Q00512_BladeUnderFoot/36403-08.htm.text: Gludio Prison Warden: Thank you for volunteering to help, kind adventurer, but we can't allow inexperienced clan members to put themselves in jeopardy -- bad for our reputation, you know. Believe it or not, I was once a prominent adventurer before taking this job. If I can give you some advice, you…

Q00512_BladeUnderFoot/36403-09.html.text: Gludio Prison Warden: So you eradicated the leader of the monster prisoners in the dungeon? Well done! Thank you for your help in eliminating this threat to our safety. Here is the Knight's Epaulette as promised. You can exchange it with me for the castle clan supply. ... Would you like to continue…

links.text: "What are the monsters in the dungeon like?"

Q00512_BladeUnderFoot/36403-12.html.text: Gludio Prison Warden: Enter the dungeon prison and slay the prisoners. Wipe out all 3 gangs to eradicate the monsters' entire organization in the dungeon. When you defeat the leader of the last gang, bring me a piece of the monster's rank badge and I will repay you with the Knight's Epaulette, whic…

links.text: "What are the monsters in the dungeon prison like?"

Q00512_BladeUnderFoot/36403-02.htm.text: Gludio Prison Warden: Excellent! I appreciate your offer, friend. This dungeon prison was only recently discovered, and no one knows its true purpose. Some legends say that some emperor long, long ago created this dungeon as a place to secretly breed monsters for magical experiments. Others say tha…

links.text: Can you tell me more about the monsters in the dungeon?

Q00512_BladeUnderFoot/36403-04.html.text: Gludio Prison Warden: I can grant you access to the castle dungeon prison right here. Thank you for your help!

Q00512_BladeUnderFoot/36403-05.html.text: Warden: Hmm... Since the dungeon was abandoned for so long, the prisoners -- monsters all -- eventually formed an independent society. This basement camp features a very complicated network of secret passageways, which the monsters now use to move at will throughout this dungeon and even to areas o…

links.text: "That certainly explains the endless stream of monsters in the basement prison despite years of bloody suppression..."

Q00512_BladeUnderFoot/36403-06.html.text: Warden: Correct. That is why we seek assistance from the clan's adventurers. Undoubtedly, a permanent solution is being studied by high class strategists, scholars and mystics. But those efforts are hampered by the disharmony among the various castles. Unless there is some sort of ultimate resoluti…

links.text: "What do you want me to do?"

Q00512_BladeUnderFoot/36403-07.html.text: Warden: Long ago, there was a great battle between monsters and a large punitive force. What a fight that was... Both sides suffered enormous casualties. In its aftermath, however, the monsters became more cautious in their movements. But recently we have observed 3 powerful gangs of monster ex-pri…

Q00512_BladeUnderFoot/36403-10.html.text: Prison Warden: Continue to seek out and defeat Beautiful Atrielle, Nagen the Tomboy and Jax the Destroyer , who are the leaders of the 3 underground prison gangs that roam this prison . Bring me the rank badges of the monsters you defeat there and I will exchange them for a Knight's Epaulette. Good…

Q00512_BladeUnderFoot/36403-11.html.text: Gludio Prison Warden: Ah, I understand -- no doubt another adventure calls you... Thank you for all you've done here. If you'd like to lend a hand again, we'd be very grateful. Good luck on your journeys!
